what_happened: Refined the dispatch's own tentative middle-ruling: the three-way deadline fork from the local-gate case (task 343) does NOT transfer verbatim to a dispatched-subagent wait, because an async Agent dispatch exposes no PID/status primitive to poll -- so the recommended rule is a flat MUST NOT on backgrounding-and-waiting, not a bounded-deadline allowance. Also confirmed the cited 17-minute 'stranding' incident was a misdiagnosis (agent was alive, actively rewriting its report) with no confirmed stranding evidence; only a separate, already-fixed fork prompt-scoping defect was real.
